28111-moment-of-truth.title: Moment Of Truth
28111-moment-of-truth.creator: Unknown
28111-moment-of-truth.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. She laughed over at the demurely sitting doll. Essie had been her favorite doll when she was younger. Of course now that she was fourteen she did not play with dolls any more. But it was permissible that she keep her old friend neatly dressed and ever at hand as a confidant. She smiled at the thought.

arxiv-2107-00015.title: Simulating Reflected Light Exoplanet Spectra of the Promising Direct Imaging Target, υ \upsilon And d, with a New, Fast Sampling Method using the Planetary Spectrum Generator
arxiv-2107-00015.creator: Prabal Saxena, Geronimo L. Villanueva, Neil T. Zimmerman, Avi M. Mandell, Adam J. R. W. Smith
arxiv-2107-00015.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Prabal Saxena, Geronimo L. Villanueva, Neil T. Zimmerman, Avi M. Mandell, Adam J. R. W. Smith. Simulations of exoplanet albedo profiles are key to planning and interpreting future direct imaging observations. In this paper we demonstrate the use of the Planetary Spectrum Generator (PSG) to produce simulations of reflected light exoplanet spectra.

arxiv-2107-14289.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by R. D. Strauss, dutoit.strauss@nwu.ac.za, C. van der Merwe, cobus.vandermerwe29@gmail.com, C. Diedericks, 27863840@nwu.ac.za, H. Krüger, helenakruger6@gmail.com, H. G. Krüger, hendrik.kriiger@gmail.com, K. D. Moloto, katlego.moloto@nwu.ac.za, S. Lotz, slotz@sansa.org.za, G. M. Mosotho, mosothomoshego. Neutron monitors have been the premier ground-based instruments for monitoring the near-Earth cosmic ray flux for more than 70 years. It is essential to continue with such measurements in order to extend this unique long-term time series.

arxiv-2206-14913.title: GPTs at Factify 2022: Prompt Aided Fact-Verification
arxiv-2206-14913.creator: Saksham Aggarwal, Pawan Kumar Sahu, Taneesh Gupta, Gyanendra Das
arxiv-2206-14913.description: Abstract One of the most pressing societal issues is the fight against false news. The false claims, as difficult as they are to expose, create a lot of damage. To tackle the problem, fact verification becomes crucial and thus has been a topic of interest among diverse research communities.

arxiv-2303-17549.title: Witnessing entanglement of remote particles with incomplete teleportation
arxiv-2303-17549.creator: Vahid Jannessary, Fatemeh Rezazadeh, Sadegh Raeisi, Vahid Karimipour
arxiv-2303-17549.description: Abstract Having common reference frames or aligned coordinate systems, is one of the presumptions in witnessing entanglement in a two-party state possessed by two remote parties. This assumption may fail for many reasons. With an unlimited supply of singlet states, the two parties can first align their coordinate systems and then measure any entanglement witness.

arxiv-2309-11804.title: FGFusion: Fine-Grained Lidar-Camera Fusion for 3D Object Detection
arxiv-2309-11804.creator: Zixuan Yin, Han Sun 🖂, Ningzhong Liu, Huiyu Zhou, Jiaquan Shen
arxiv-2309-11804.description: Abstract Lidars and cameras are critical sensors that provide complementary information for 3D detection in autonomous driving. While most prevalent methods progressively downscale the 3D point clouds and camera images and then fuse the high-level features, the downscaled features inevitably lose low-level detailed information.

arxiv-2406-15228.title: Solving the Product Breakdown Structure Problem with constrained QAOA
arxiv-2406-15228.creator: René Zander, Raphael Seidel, Matteo Inajetovic, Niklas Steinmann, Matic Petrič
arxiv-2406-15228.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by René Zander, Raphael Seidel, Matteo Inajetovic, Niklas Steinmann, Matic Petrič. Constrained optimization problems, where not all possible variable assignments are feasible solutions, comprise numerous practically relevant optimization problems such as the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP), or portfolio optimization. Established methods such as quantum annealing or vanilla QAOA usually transform the problem statement into a QUBO (Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization) form, where the constraints are enforced by auxiliary terms in the QUBO objective.

arxiv-2410-08010.title: Securing HHL Quantum Algorithm against Quantum Computer Attacks
arxiv-2410-08010.creator: Yizhuo Tan, Hrvoje Kukina, Jakub Szefer
arxiv-2410-08010.description: Abstract As the quantum research community expands and new quantum algorithms are created and implemented, it is essential to consider the security implications and potential threats that could lead to the compromise the information processed by them. This work focuses on securing the HHL quantum algorithm against attacks while it executes on a quantum computer.

arxiv-2410-09686.title: Generalization of Compositional Tasks with Logical Specification via Implicit Planning
arxiv-2410-09686.creator: Duo Xu, Faramarz Fekri
arxiv-2410-09686.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Duo Xu, Faramarz Fekri. In this study, we address the challenge of learning generalizable policies for compositional tasks defined by logical specifications. These tasks consist of multiple temporally extended sub-tasks. Due to the sub-task inter-dependencies and sparse reward issue in long-horizon tasks, existing reinforcement learning (RL) approaches, such as task-conditioned and goal-conditioned policies, continue to struggle with slow convergence and sub-optimal performance in generalizing to compositional tasks.

arxiv-2509-18272.title: StereoFoley: Object-Aware Stereo Audio Generation from Video
arxiv-2509-18272.creator: Tornike Karchkhadze 1 \sthanks Work completed during internship at Apple., Kuan-Lin Chen 2 , Mojtaba Heydari 2 , Robert Henzel 2 , Alessandro Toso 2 , Mehrez Souden 2 , Joshua Atkins 2
arxiv-2509-18272.description: Abstract We present StereoFoley, a video-to-audio generation framework that produces semantically aligned, temporally synchronized, and spatially accurate stereo sound at 48 kHz. While recent generative video-to-audio models achieve strong semantic and temporal fidelity, they largely remain limited to mono or fail to deliver object-aware stereo imaging, constrained by the lack of professionally mixed, spatially accurate video-to-audio datasets.

arxiv-2512-06143.title: gp2Scale : A Class of Compactly-Supported Non-Stationary Kernels and Distributed Computing for Exact Gaussian Processes on 10 Million Data Points
arxiv-2512-06143.creator: Marcus M. Noack, Mark D. Risser, Hengrui Luo, Vardaan Tekriwal, Ronald J. Pandolfi
arxiv-2512-06143.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Marcus M. Noack, Mark D. Risser, Hengrui Luo, Vardaan Tekriwal, Ronald J. Pandolfi. Despite a large corpus of recent work on scaling up Gaussian processes, a stubborn trade-off between computational speed, prediction and uncertainty quantification accuracy, and customizability persists. This is because the vast majority of existing methodologies exploit various levels of approximations that lower accuracy and limit the flexibility of kernel and noise-model designs — an unacceptable drawback at a time when expressive non-stationary kernels are on the rise in many fields.

britannica-1911-geldern.title: Geldern (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-geldern.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-geldern.description: Article 'Geldern' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 11), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. of Düsseldorf, at the junction of railways to Wesel and Cologne. It has an Evangelical and two Roman Catholic churches and a town hall with a fine council chamber. Its industries include the manufacture of buttons, shoes, cigars and soap. The town dates from about 1100 and was early an important fortified place; until 1371 it was the residence of the counts and dukes of Gelderland.

pmc-11510379.creator: Hongjuan Zhang, Zhen Yang, Baocheng Hao, Di Wu, Dan Shao, Yu Liu, Wanxia Pu, Shouli Yi, Ruofeng Shang, Shengyi Wang, Constantinos K Zacharis
pmc-11510379.description: The aim of the present study was to establish a simple and reliable ultra-high-performance liquid chromatography tandem mass spectrometry (UHPLC-MS/MS) method and apply it for the determination of pharmacokinetics of moxidectin-loaded microspheres (MOX-MS) in rats. Plasma samples were processed using a simplified liquid–liquid extraction method and were separated using an Agilent Zorbax Eclipse Plus C18 column (50 mm × 2.

pmc-11653366.title: The conformation of the nSrc specificity-determining loop in the Src SH3 domain is modulated by a WX conserved sequence motif found in SH3 domains
pmc-11653366.creator: Frederick Longshore-Neate, Caroline Ceravolo, Cole Masuga, Elise F. Tahti, Jadon M. Blount, Sarah N. Smith, Jeanine F. Amacher
pmc-11653366.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Cellular signaling networks are modulated by multiple protein-protein interaction domains that coordinate extracellular inputs and processes to regulate cellular processes. Several of these domains recognize short linear motifs, or SLiMs, which are often highly conserved and are closely regulated. One such domain, the Src homology 3 (SH3) domain, typically recognizes proline-rich SLiMs and is one of the most abundant SLiM-binding domains in the human proteome.

pmc-11782226.title: GRHL2-HER3 and E-cadherin mediate EGFR-bypass drug resistance in lung cancer cells
pmc-11782226.creator: Fumiya Ito, Wakiko Iwata, Yoshihiro Adachi, Hiromi Sesaki, Miho Iijima
pmc-11782226.description: Epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) is a major oncogenic protein, and thus EGFR-targeting therapies are widely used in patients with various types of cancer, including lung cancer. However, resistance to EGFR inhibitors, such as erlotinib, presents a significant challenge in treating lung cancer.

pmc-12542076.title: Danon disease in male patients: a prospective natural history study to augment understanding of the phenotype
pmc-12542076.creator: Tarek Khedro, Jennifer Attias, Emily Eshraghian, Melina Tsotras, Emily Margolin, Shaden Yassin, Elizabeth Silver, Quan Bui, Shyamanga Borooah, Chamindra G. Laverty, Matthew R. G. Taylor, Eric D. Adler, Kimberly N. Hong
pmc-12542076.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundDanon disease (DD) is a rare X-linked cardioskeletal myopathy caused by pathogenic mutations in lysosomal-associated membrane protein-2 (LAMP2). It is a multisystemic disease that affects the heart, skeletal, neurologic and ophthalmic systems. With an early age of onset especially in males and no treatment for the cardiomyopathy outside of heart transplant, natural history studies have been paramount to providing clinical data for the development and advancement of disease-focused therapies.

pmc-12652951.title: How Women with Endometriosis Use Social Media for Support and Self-Management: An Analysis of Reddit Content
pmc-12652951.creator: Alaina Loughran, Kirstie Daken, Carol du Plessis, Amy B Mullens, Nicola Magnavita
pmc-12652951.description: Women with endometriosis often experience insufficient knowledge and support regarding their condition within the healthcare system. Women use social media to obtain information, share personal experiences, and establish connections with others. This study examined how women with endometriosis-like symptoms use Reddit to seek support and acquire knowledge for self-management, with three research questions guided by the Information–Motivation–Behavioural skills model.

pmc-13112397.description: Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) are emerging contaminants whose bioremediation becomes challenging under multiple environmental stressors. This study evaluates the resilience and NSAID tolerance of Bacillus safensis HS4–2 and Bacillus haynesii TXO1–1SG1. The two strains were isolated from saline-sodium sediment. They were tested independently for tolerance to salinity (0 – 3.

pmc-13197831.title: Mendelian Randomization Revealed Potential of mTOR Inhibitors for Treatment of Osteoporosis: Evidence From GWAS and Transcriptome Data
pmc-13197831.creator: ZhaoLiang Zhang, LiMing Zhou, LieHui Yao, Tao Ma, YunFei Xu, Suraiya Saleem
pmc-13197831.description: AimsNumerous preclinical studies suggested that targeted inhibition of mammalian target of rapamycin (mTOR) may be beneficial for the treatment of osteoporosis. However, the relevance of these findings to human populations remains unclear. We hypothesized that lifelong genetically higher mTOR expression leads to reduced bone mineral density (BMD), and we use Mendelian randomization to estimate its causal effect.

pmc-13214145.title: Automatic and explainable assessment for Parkinson’s disease by video-based human motion understanding
pmc-13214145.creator: Mengqi Liu, Yixing Ye, Haolun Li, Yijing Guo, Ping Liang, Xuemei Li, Chunyu Yin, Xinguang Yu, Xinyuan Dong, Yiqin Yao, Chi-Man Pun, Jing Xie, Kun Yang, Rui Zong, Dongsheng Kong, Feng Xu, Hao Gao
pmc-13214145.description: BackgroundThe assessment of Parkinson’s disease depends heavily on neurologist experience and involves significant clinical workload, where standard motor examinations require substantial time and face-to-face evaluation, limiting accessibility for patients with mobility constraints. Furthermore, current rating scales contain subjective definitions that lead to rating inconsistencies among clinicians.

pmc-13444106.title: In silico DFT, ADMET and molecular docking studies of novel coumarin-linked pyrazole and quinoline derivatives as antimicrobial and antioxidant agents
pmc-13444106.creator: Nargis H. Shaikh, Jay B. Maheta, Darshna K. Lakhnotra, Prince A. Dave, Ila M. Ram, Dharmesh N. Sherathia, Dharmesh K. Katariya, Hardik B. Bhatt, Yogesh O. Bhola, Swanti A. Jain
pmc-13444106.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Ten novel coumarin-based hybrids comprising coumarin–pyrazole (7a–e) and coumarin–quinoline (11a–e) derivatives were synthesized via multistep reactions and characterized spectroscopically. Solvent optimization identified DMF: Ethanol (1:1) with H2SO4 as optimal conditions, achieving 88% yield in 2–3 h. Antimicrobial evaluation against four bacterial strains (Bacillus subtilis, Staphylococcus aureus, Escherichia coli, Acinetobacter baumannii) and one fungal strain (Aspergillus niger) revealed compound 7a as the most potent (MIC: 25 μg/mL), superior to standard drugs.

pmc-13647624.title: Lifetime cumulative effect of reproductive factors, “Life’s essential 8” health status and risk of chronic kidney disease: a nationwide prospective cohort study
pmc-13647624.creator: Xiaoli Xu, Yuchen Xu, Yi Ding, Yuanyue Zhu, Yiping Xu, Min Xu, Yu Xu, Tiange Wang, Yuhong Chen, Shuangyuan Wang, Hong Lin, Zhiyun Zhao, Jieli Lu, Jie Zheng, Guijun Qin, Li Yan, Lixin Shi, Zhengnan Gao, Lulu Chen, Tianshu Zeng, Ruying Hu, Zhen Ye, Xuefeng Yu, Gang Chen, Qing Su, Yiming Mu, Xulei Tang
pmc-13647624.description: BackgroundLittle has been found regarding the lifetime cumulative effect of reproductive factors on chronic kidney disease (CKD), and how this relationship varies with cardiovascular health (CVH) remains unexplored. This study aimed to assess the relationships of lifetime cumulative estrogen exposure reflected by reproductive factors, and LE8 CVH status with incident CKD among postmenopausal women.
